about: The theme pipeline's queue (docs/themes/PIPELINE.md, D31): one theme in its pass at a time. 'active' are the themes in a pass now (theme-pass.sh start refuses another while one is listed; theme-pass.sh done <theme> takes it off). 'queue' is the order after them (the user: alphabetical). 'control' would hold themes never refined; none: Baseline is refined too (the stock look drawn by the theme engine; jellyfin-web is its own choice).
